tasks.subject: Task 0: Infrastructure i18n (config + middleware + Carbon)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Résolution de locale côté serveur : Setting('locale') → Accept-Language → fallback fr ; applique app()->setLocale + Carbon::setLocale.

```json:metadata
{"files":["app/Http/Middleware/SetLocale.php","bootstrap/app.php","config/app.php",".env.example","tests/Feature/SetLocaleTest.php"],"verifyCommand":"php artisan test --filter=SetLocaleTest","acceptanceCriteria":["Accept-Language en/fr/absent résolu correctement","Setting override l'auto-détection","Setting invalide ignoré","Carbon locale suit"]}
```
